questions.question: What does chapter 15 mostly record?
options: A great and prolonged war against the Philistines
The reigns of several kings of Judah and Israel
The building of the temple of the LORD in Jerusalem
A severe famine that struck both of the kingdoms
questions.answer: The reigns of several kings of Judah and Israel
